references.text: The Egyptians felt the same fear for the people of Israel because of their great numbers, just as Moab feared here.
Moses' song predicted that Moab's leaders would tremble with fear for Israel.
Israel's victory over Og, king of Bashan, was one reason why Moab feared them.
Israel's victory over the Amorites and King Sihon explains why Moab was afraid.
God said he would put fear of Israel over all peoples, which is fulfilled in Moab's terror.
Joshua reminds Israel that Balak, king of Moab, rose up against them because of fear.
Jephthah refers to Balak and how he dealt with Israel out of fear.
